headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 29, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Franco Aleman dominated on the mound with 5 strikeouts in 2 innings of work. The Guardians' win marked a notable upset in a day filled with exciting matchups.

Several key players will be sidelined due to injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with right wrist soreness. Casey Schmitt (San Francisco Giants) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left knee meniscus tear. Other notable injured players include Beck Way (Kansas City Royals), Cole Sands (Minnesota Twins), Kerry Carpenter (Detroit Tigers), Spencer Steer (Cincinnati Reds), Cody Bellinger (New York Yankees), and Shea Langeliers (Athletics).

Several trades and roster moves have been made, shaking up teams' lineups. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. The San Diego Padres signed Nu'u Contrades, while the Athletics acquired Scott Blewett from the St. Louis Cardinals for cash. The Chicago White Sox traded for RHP José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates, sending RHP Felix Doroteo in return. The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Franco Aleman dominated on the mound with 5 strikeouts in 2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jose Franco earning the win. In the game, JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run, his 18th of the season.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, outlasting their opponents by a single run. Brandon Lowe led the Diamondbacks' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, including a home run, and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 6-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players making significant contributions to the final score. Impact hitters for the Marlins included Trea Turner, Justin Crawford, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Esteury Ruiz, and Griffin Conine.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Gabriel Moreno and Max Kepler contributing to the winning effort. Jared Triolo also made an impact in the game.

top_news.title: **Vinnie Pasquantino Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals first baseman Vinnie Pasquantino has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right wrist soreness.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, who received cash in return.
